name: Runner Tests Fixture - Failed Test Rollback Boundary
brief: Regression test: writes made by a [Test] that FAILS must not survive into the next [Test] of the same codeunit (#2523).
description: BC's NavTestCodeunit.ExecuteTestMethodAsync wraps every test method in `catch (Exception ex) { if (activeSession.IsTransactionActive()) activeSession.Rollback(); MarkExceptions(ex); }`, so a failing test's uncommitted writes are undone before the next test runs, while a PASSING test's writes are committed and do survive. This fixture pins both halves. Two of its four tests fail on purpose; FailedTestRollbackBoundaryTests.cs asserts their exact messages, which is how the deliberate failures stay legible instead of looking like a broken fixture.
